tables.name: Resident - Great Person
tables.description: Special Feature specifics: Resident - Great Person.

results.name: Hero
results.description: A person known for their good deeds, performed selflessly for the benefit of others.

results.name: Villain
results.description: A person known for committing dreadful atrocities.

results.name: Thinker
results.description: A person known for their wisdom and enlightenment (such as a philosopher, naturalist, scientist, etc).

results.name: Artist
results.description: A person known for creating works of exceptional beauty.

results.name: Writer
results.description: A person who is known for their exquisite written prowess, having spun riveting tales or accounted pivotal events.

results.name: Warrior
results.description: A person known for their martial prowess, or valor, in battle.

results.name: Arcanist
results.description: A person known for their magical ability or expertise.

results.name: Priest
results.description: A person known for having a special connection to the divine.
